one_liner: Pipedrive has a broad REST API (v1/v2) with self-serve OAuth 2.0 app registration, API tokens, a free developer sandbox, and an official MCP server, so a toolkit is buildable now.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow via oauth.pipedrive.com; apps are registered in the Developer Hub to get a client_id and client_secret. Personal API tokens (x-api-token header) also work and are tied to one user.
access_notes: A free developer sandbox account is available at developers.pipedrive.com. One source says the sandbox needs a paid plan, which conflicts with the others. There is no free product plan, but a 14-day trial exists. API access is included on every plan.
blocker_notes: Nothing major. Sandbox availability is slightly disputed, but a 14-day trial and API tokens on every plan are fallbacks. A daily token budget applies as a rate limit, which is not friction.

evidence.quote: The API token must be provided in the `x-api-token` header for all requests
